text: 从中国汽车工业协会获悉，7月份我国汽车出口表现亮眼，延续强劲增长态势。最新发布的数据显示，今年7月份，汽车出口104.3万辆，环比增长0.6%，同比增长81.3%。其中，新能源汽车出口55.3万辆，环比增长5.7%，同比增长145.5%。（央视新闻）
text_en: According to the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, China's auto exports in July performed strongly, continuing robust growth momentum. Latest data show that in July this year, auto exports reached 1.043 million units, up 0.6% month-on-month and 81.3% year-on-year. Among them, new energy vehicle exports were 553,000 units, up 5.7% month-on-month and 145.5% year-on-year. (CCTV News)
